title: Online Chess Reached 200 Million Members Beyond One TV Show
hook: Online chess reached 200 million members; one show only accelerated it.
closing: Entertainment sparked attention, but the lasting habit grew much larger than one release.
question: What pulled you into chess?

segments.say: Chess.com reached 200 million members, showing the boom continued years beyond one television release.
Monthly chess signups hit 2.8 million after the release, accelerating growth already underway.
Chess.com holds about 33% of regular players, leaving the online game substantial room to grow.
